segments.text:
V. 24.
One was brought who owed him ten thouſand talents—According to the uſual Computation, if theſe were Talents of Gold, this would amount to ſeventy-two Millions Sterling. If they were Talents of Silver, it muſt have been four Millions, four hundred thouſand Pounds. Hereby our LORD intimates the vaſt Number and Weight of our Offences againſt GOD, and our utter Incapacity of making H•m any Satisfaction.
